description: This file provides utility functions for handling recipe image URLs in a React-based project. It includes methods to generate placeholder image paths and to normalize various forms of image source URLs into safe, absolute paths suitable for client-side rendering.

methods.name: getPlaceholder(kind = "card")
methods.description: Returns a public path to a placeholder image used when no valid image source is provided. Defaults to the 'card' kind and points to a predefined assets location.

methods.name: normalizeRecipeImage(src)
methods.description: Transforms a given image source string into a safe, absolute URL that can be served by Create React App. Handles missing, absolute, relative, and specific asset paths to ensure proper image rendering.
